description: No icon_code -> property20 pair is currently proven by saved APK evidence. The client property20 resource rule is known, but icon association remains unresolved.

Current appearance audit recovered only image 21003 as a property20 candidate.

The compatibility item 青纹盔 uses icon_code 109 and property20=3, but repository evidence explicitly says 青纹套装 is local compatibility data and must not be treated as an official icon-to-appearance mapping.
Therefore icon_code 100..109 are all unresolved until direct APK/resource or original-server evidence establishes a pair.
Unknown or unresolved icon_code values resolve to 0/no added helmet layer.
